message.reasoning:
Let me evaluate against criteria.

C1 Introduction: mission concept (coral reef monitoring, fluid lensing), why needed (bleaching), number of spacecraft (one, justified), users — operator and customers? The report says "operated and accessed from Australia ground facilities" but doesn't clearly identify operator and customers (e.g., University of Tasmania operates ground station; customers = marine/conservation scientists). Users partially addressed: "marine and conservation scientists" mentioned as beneficiaries. Operator not explicitly named. So Adequate level, maybe 6. References present. I'd give 6.

C2 Mission design: launch (Vega E from Kourou, justified), orbit (SSO, 600 km, inclination 87.79°, elements table), maneuvers (only EOL), ground control (Mt Pleasant, STK access report), comms frequency (access table, ~20 min mean), mission duration (5 years) and EOL (drag sail). Software STK screenshots included. Some technical errors: Kourou latitude stated as 45.05°N — actually ~5.2°N; that's a significant error. Also "45.05°N... smaller than target inclination... two launch windows per day" — logic flawed. Also inclination 87.79° at 600 km — check: sun-sync inclination at 600 km is ~97.8°, not 87.79°. The plot shows inclination vs altitude increasing from ~96.5 at 200km to 99.5 at 1000km — that's retrograde inclinations >90°. But the student says 87.79°, which contradicts their own plot and "retrograde" claim. 87.79° is prograde, not retrograde, and not sun-synchronous. Major technical error. Also semi-major axis 7171 km correct (6371+600... actually 6971? 6371+600=6971, not 7171!). Wait: 6371+600 = 6971 km. Student wrote 7171 km — arithmetic error (or used 6571 radius?). Actually 7171-600 = 6571, wrong Earth radius. Error. Also RAAN 27.33° "indicates location of launch facility" — Kourou is ~52°W, so RAAN should be negative/-52ish; 27.33° doesn't match. Also "mean inclination of 87.7924°" contradicts plot. Also "average contact duration of almost twenty minutes" — mean 580.786 s ≈ 9.7 min, not 20 min. Error. Also "very high altitude would yield low resolution images which is also desirable" — should be "not desirable" (typo but meaning wrong). Also drag sail section has broken sentence. Also "45.05°N" for Kourou (actually 5.05°N? Kourou latitude ~5.2°N; 45.05 likely typo of 5.05). Hmm, could be OCR? "latitude of $45.05^{\circ}$N" — likely student error of 5.05°N. But even 5.05°N < inclination, so two windows per day logic holds for any latitude below inclination... Actually for launch into inclination i, if launch site latitude < i, there are two windows per day. So logic fine if 5.05. But written 45.05.

Also inclination error: at 600 km, sun-sync inclination ≈ 97.79°, not 87.79°. Possibly dropped the 9. The plot shows ~97.8 at 600 km. So the text value 87.79 is inconsistent with their own figure — likely typo but propagated into COE table and STK? STK images show near-polar orbit. The table says 87.79°. This is a notable inconsistency.

Also semi-major axis 7171 vs 6971 — error.

Despite errors, most requirements addressed with STK evidence. Level: between Adequate and Accomplished. Errors are significant (inclination, SMA, contact duration claim, Kourou latitude). I'd say Adequate high: 6. Or Accomplished low 7? The rubric Accomplished requires "accurate". Multiple inaccuracies → Adequate, mark 6.

C3 Conclusion: summarizes findings, acknowledges risk (Vega E not built). Some detail. Adequate-to-accomplished. It's reasonably specific. I'd give 6-7. It reaches conclusions tied to evidence but somewhat brief. Give 6.

C4 Presentation: structure clear, headings, exec summary, figures labeled? Figures have captions like "STK 3D view of orbit: 12 hours apart" but no figure numbers ("Figure 1"). Tables not numbered. References cited in text with [n], bibliography matches mostly. Wikipedia used as source [6] — task says Wikipedia not acceptable. Some grammar issues ("which is also desirable", "for the purposed of this satellite", broken sentences). TOC present. I'd say Adequate, 5-6. Given Wikipedia use, unnumbered figures, some writing flaws: 5.

Requirements:
R1 yes (Introduction).
R2 yes (one satellite justified).
R3 partial (customers implied—marine scientists; operator not clearly identified).
R4 yes (Kourou, Vega E).
R5 partial (orbit type and elements given, but inclination/SMA errors).
R6 yes (no maneuvers except EOL; stated).
R7 yes (Mt Pleasant, access table).
R8 yes (5 years, drag sail EOL).
R9 yes (STK used).
R10 partial (screenshots included; no mention of STK files in appendix — deliverable says include files; report doesn't state appendix). Actually no appendix present. Partial.
R11 partial (Wikipedia cited, structure ok but figure numbering inconsistent).

Technical issues list: inclination 87.79 vs required ~97.8 (contradicts own plot and retrograde claim); SMA 7171 km should be 6971 km; Kourou latitude 45.05°N (actual ~5.2°N); mean contact duration "almost twenty minutes" vs 580.8 s (~9.7 min); RAAN 27.33° inconsistent with Kourou location; "low resolution images which is also desirable" contradiction; Wikipedia source not acceptable; figures lack numbers.

Overall: solid concept and STK work undermined by several numerical errors and presentation issues.
